answer_sql:
SELECT
  p.brand,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.country_code <> '--' THEN s.country_code END) AS how_many_countries_sold_in
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON l.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS s
  ON l.store_key = s.store_key
GROUP BY
  p.brand
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.country_code <> '--' THEN s.country_code END) = (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT country_code)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_country
    WHERE
      country_code <> '--'
  )
ORDER BY
  p.brand

sections.title: What it says its rows are

body.value: All 11 brands Contoso sells, each sold in all 8 of the countries it sells in — one row per brand, and every row reads 8. The figure on a row is the number of distinct countries holding at least one sale of that brand, over every sales line ever recorded: 223,974 lines, orders from 2016-05-18 to 2025-12-31, shops and web shop together, each country counted once however many sales it holds. THE ANSWER IS "ALL OF THEM" — the "every country" test disqualified no brand, so this list is the brand list, and the honest headline is that brand coverage is universal here rather than that eleven particular brands achieved something. NOT INCLUDED: the '--' / 'Online' sentinel, which is not a place, so the bar is 8 and not 9; no date window, no channel filter, no trading-state filter, so sales rung up by shops that have since closed still count for their country; and no notion of availability — a brand is here because it was BOUGHT in all 8 countries, not because it was listed in them. I cannot report which countries a brand misses, because none misses any.

WITH per_brand AS (
  SELECT
    p.brand,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.country_code <> '--' THEN s.country_code END) AS cs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cu.country_code) AS cc
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
  JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
    ON l.product_key = p.product_key
  JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS s
    ON l.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS cu
    ON l.customer_key = cu.customer_key
  GROUP BY
    p.brand
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS brands_sold,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cs = 8 AND cc = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brands_in_all_8_both_routes,
  MIN(cs) AS fewest_countries_via_store,
  MIN(cc) AS fewest_countries_via_customer,
  COALESCE(
    LISTAGG(
      CASE WHEN cs < 8 OR cc < 8 THEN brand || ' (' || cs || '/' || cc || ')' END, ', '
    ),
    'none'
  ) AS brands_short_of_8
FROM per_brand

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT country_code) AS all_countries
  FROM contoso_served.dim_country
  WHERE
    country_code <> '--'
), per_brand AS (
  SELECT
    p.brand,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.country_code <> '--' THEN s.country_code END) AS countries_sold_in
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
  JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
    ON l.product_key = p.product_key
  JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS s
    ON l.store_key = s.store_key
  GROUP BY
    p.brand
)
SELECT
  (
    SELECT
      all_countries
    FROM totals
  ) AS the_bar,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    countries_sold_in = (
      SELECT
        all_countries
      FROM totals
    )) AS qualifying_brands,
  COUNT(*) AS brands_sold_at_all,
  LISTAGG(brand || ' (' || countries_sold_in || ')', ' | '
  ORDER BY
    brand) FILTER(WHERE
    countries_sold_in = (
      SELECT
        all_countries
      FROM totals
    )) AS brands_in_every_country,
  COALESCE(
    LISTAGG(brand || ' (' || countries_sold_in || ')', ' | '
    ORDER BY
      brand) FILTER(WHERE
      countries_sold_in < (
        SELECT
          all_countries
        FROM totals
      )),
    'none'
  ) AS brands_falling_short
FROM per_brand
